crossRefs.note: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;
May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another, and toward all men, even as we also do toward…
But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one…
for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound…
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother…
By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass, or a clanging…
So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the…
Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
